<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:14">Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 39:15">XXXIX, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 3:16">Targ. II Chr. III, 16</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:1:4">Y. Sabb. VI, beg. 7ᵈ</cite> <he>מהו מיפק באילין ת׳</he> how about going out (on the Sabbath) with those cord chains (as a belt)? Bab.
